text:
maya: Heads up: drafting relnotes for the next docs release — two items: policy-based routing (new beta) and prefix cache v2. Also need a short known-issue blurb about transient 503s on Dedicated during GPU warmup. Anyone free to eyeball the draft?
ryan: I can take a pass on the blurb. For the routing bit, suggest we label it 'policy-based routing (beta)' and call out fallback order (latency -> cost -> region). Keep it concise.
sasha: SDK snippets need updating: python client now uses client.predict(..., routing_policy='cost'). I'll open a snippet PR. Ping me the relnotes path.
maya: PR is at https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/1234 — relnotes live under content/releases/next.md. Let's avoid pasting long API details, just link to the SDK reference.
tim: I'll run linkcheck once the PR lands. Quick note: draft currently references /guides/old-batching which is stale.
sasha: On migration guide: add a tiny 'v1 -> v2 cache' section with a code diff example. Draft snippet: ```diff
- cache.enable(false)
+ cache.enable(true)
+ cache.version = "v2"
```
ryan: For the known-issue line I recommend: "Some Dedicated clusters may return transient 503s during GPU warmup; retrying after 30s typically succeeds. A fix is rolling out." One sentence.
maya: :thumbsup: Good. Plan: sasha updates snippets, tim runs linkcheck and fixes redirects, ryan finalizes blurb, I merge once everything's green. Can we aim for EOD?
tim: Linkcheck found 2 redirects and one dead anchor; fixed redirects in #1240, leaving anchor to be corrected in the SDK reference.
docs-bot: deploy-bot deployed branch docs/relnotes-1769004321 to staging — tests passed.
sasha: Snippet PR #1236 added `client.set_cache_mode("v2")` example and a short migration note.
ryan: Final blurb suggestion: "Beta: Policy-based routing lets you prefer low-cost GPUs for non-latency-sensitive traffic; automatic fallbacks keep critical paths stable." Short, factual.
maya: Perfect. Merging now. :partyparrot:
maya: Post-merge checklist: 1) confirm linkcheck passed on prod build, 2) add homepage bullet: tim?
tim: I'll add homepage bullet: "Policy-based routing (beta) and faster prefix caching (v2). See release notes." Will push to content/home.md in a follow-up PR.
maya: Thanks all — nice quick turnaround. If any regressions surface open a postmortem thread and tag me.
